content.text: Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 already contains a Vendor-side insurance covenant that meets or exceeds our preferred position: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability of USD 1M), professional E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M, maintained at Vendor's expense throughout the term and for one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds reputable insurers, primary coverage, certificates of insurance and evidence on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — so the coverage does not cap the liability and indemnity provisions in Sections 20 and 21. The obligations run against Vendor and benefit us, and Vendor processes Customer Data (Sections 15 and 17), which the USD 5M cyber limit addresses. No edit required.
